arrowKeys.name: Arrow keys move tokens
arrowKeys.hint: The arrow keys move the selected token and W A S D does nothing; the numpad pans the map. Applied on every player's client, with nothing for them to set. Off returns every client to Foundry's defaults.

goingDown.name: Going down costs a level of Exhaustion
goingDown.hint: Each time a creature's Hit Points go from above 0 to 0 it gains one level of Exhaustion, at the drop, the sixth being death under the 2024 rules. Every way down counts: damage from a card, a drop save failed after a hold at 1, a hold declined, a GM's edit on the sheet; a creature held at 1 pays nothing. The level is written with the Hit Points, so By the Books' damage receipt records it and its Revert takes it back. Off: nothing happens at 0.

sidebarTabs.name: Players see only the sidebar tabs they use
sidebarTabs.hint: Players lose the Combat, Placeables, Items, Rollable Tables, Cards and Macros tabs: no button, open or collapsed, and no way to switch or pop one out. Chat, Actors, Journal, Playlists, Compendium Packs, Settings and any tab a module adds stay. A GM's tabs are the rule below's. Turning it off brings the tabs back when each client reloads.

gmSidebarTabs.name: GMs see only the sidebar tabs they use
gmSidebarTabs.hint: GMs lose the Combat, Rollable Tables, Cards and Macros tabs: no button, and no way to switch or pop one out. Chat, Scenes, Placeables, Actors, Items, Journal, Playlists, Compendium Packs, Settings and any tab a module adds stay. Players' tabs are the rule above's. Turning it off brings the tabs back when each client reloads.

arrowKeys.restored: arrow keys rule off: {n} binding(s) back to Foundry's defaults ({why}).
